name: @agntn/forges
stderr:
One API for GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, GitBucket, and Cloudflare Artifacts (forges v0.5.1)

USAGE forges <command> [OPTIONS]

COMMANDS

  repos-list                     List the repositories owned by one user or organization on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, or Forgejo, or in a Cloudflare Artifacts namespace, normalized to one shape.
  repos-get                      Get one repository by owner and name, normalized across platforms: description, visibility, default branch, fork parent, viewer permission, merge settings, web and clone URL, and owner.
  repos-contents                 Read one file or directory of a repository at a branch, tag or commit; ref defaults to the default branch.
  repos-tags                     List the Git tags of one repository, each with the commit it points at.
  contribution-templates-list    List paged metadata for the effective issue or pull-request templates of one repository.
  contribution-templates-get     Get the full source body of one effective issue or pull-request template.
  code-search                    Search code across repositories, optionally scoped to an owner or one repository.
  ci-runs-list                   List paged repository CI runs, normalized from GitHub Actions, GitLab pipelines, and Gitea Actions.
  ci-jobs-list                   List the jobs of one CI run with their lifecycle status, terminal conclusion, start and end times, web URL and, on GitHub and Gitea, their steps.
  ci-jobs-log                    Read one CI job log as a bounded text slice without timestamps or ANSI escapes.
  commits-search                 Search commits across repositories with optional owner and repository scope.
  commits-list                   List paged commit summaries for one repository, optionally filtered by ref, path, and ISO-8601 since/until dates.
  commits-compare                Compare two refs: the commits head has that base lacks, as git log base..head lists them, oldest first, with aheadBy and totalCount for the whole range.
  commits-get                    Get one commit by SHA with normalized author, committer, parent revisions, message, URL, and changed-file rows.
  commits-checks                 List the checks or pipelines that ran on one commit, given as a SHA, branch, or tag, in the rows forges_pull_requests_checks returns: name, lifecycle status, terminal conclusion, and URL.
  commits-patch                  Read one bounded slice of a known commit's patch stream.
  releases-list                  List the releases of one repository, newest first, each with its tag, title, draft and pre-release flags, author, creation and publication time, and URL.
  releases-get                   Get one release by its tag name with the full release notes.
  releases-create                Create a release for a tag, creating the tag from ref when it does not exist yet.
  releases-update                Update the title, notes, draft or pre-release flag of the release behind one tag.
  issues-list                    List normalized issues for one repository, optionally filtered by state.
  issues-search-global           Search issues across repositories, optionally scoped to an owner or one repository.
  issues-search                  Search issues inside one repository with the selected platform's query syntax, optionally filtered by state.
  issues-get                     Get one issue by number, including its body.
  issues-comments                List the discussion comments under one issue, oldest first.
  issues-comments-get            Get one discussion comment under an issue, with its full body.
  issues-reactions               List the emoji reactions on one issue, oldest first, or on one of its discussion comments when commentId is an id forges_issues_comments returned.
  issues-comments-create         Post a new comment in one issue's discussion.
  issues-create                  Create an issue in one repository.
  issues-update                  Change an issue: its title, its body, its open or closed state, and assignees or labels to add or remove.
  pull-requests-list
